build_single_step_prompt: build a prompt for a single step multi-agent planner using a world graph and action history
actions_parser: parse LLM-generated action strings into structured agent actions with tool names and inputs
get_world_descr: build a string description of the environment including rooms, furniture, and objects from a world graph
state_dict_to_string: convert a state dictionary like is_clean and is_powered_on into a human-readable string
pil_image_to_data_url: convert a PIL Image to a base64-encoded data URL string for embedding
